thread:
incident-bot: Pager: high GPU queue in shared-gpu-eu-west (queue=19.1k, enqueue +3.4k/s). Autoscaler retries failing; provider API 429s. Paging oncall for eu-west.
oncall-ryan: I'm awake. jumping in — pulling autoscaler and provider logs. tagging @sre-judy. ETA 2m. :coffee:
sre-judy: Logged. I see a spike starting 11:48 UTC. Provider returned RateLimitExceeded and QuotaExceeded errors at 11:53:02. Also noticed a config roll from 3h ago: eviction-guard=false enabled; that increased pod packing.
eng-platform-sam: autoscaler controller shows repeated backoff after rate limits. It refuses to request new instances due to provider quota policy. We have an idle fallthrough pool in eu-north (gpu-cold) and a CPU fallback we can accept low-quality routes on.
infra-lee: provider confirms A100 family shortage in eu-west; capacity replenishment ETA ~3h. We can ask for emergency burst but rate-limits still apply.
oncall-ryan: Live plan (short): 1) open emergency acceptor to drain queued requests to pre-warmed virtual nodes; 2) reroute free-tier & experimental routes to cpu-fallback or eu-north GPU; 3) throttle bulk-scoring keys; 4) lower low-priority decode limits. Implementing now.
oncall-ryan: /sys enable-temp-acceptor --pool tmp-burst-eu-west --ttl 5h
incident-bot: Command executed. tmp-burst-eu-west added capacity +6 nodes (virtual). Monitoring queue.
sre-judy: Suggest we also pause long-running batched jobs to reduce KV cache churn. This will help memory pressure.
eng-runtime-ana: We can gate batch-scheduler: set batch.max_seq=512 -> 256 for low-priority routes. That reduces per-request latency at some quality cost.
eng-platform-sam: Pushing route override now to reduce max_tokens for /generate on free-plan and switch streaming=true to improve tail latency. Patch: ```yaml
routes:
  /generate: {plan: free, max_tokens: 96, streaming: true}
  /batch-score: {plan: free, batching: false}
```
incident-bot: Route overrides applied. Expect ~35% reduction in GPU token throughput for free-plan.
cs-paula: CS reporting a handful of paid customers seeing increased latency on EU region. Can we get a quick paid/non-paid impact breakdown?
sre-judy: Querying logs now. Early read: paid customers on dedicated pools unaffected. Shared hosted paid customers (small amount) showed higher enqueue times but few 5xxs.
ops-nina: Hold customer-facing updates until we have concrete numbers. Draft ready but wait 20m.
oncall-ryan: queue dropped to 10.8k after reroutes and temp pool. p95 token latency down from 2.2s -> 1.6s. Provider 429s trending down after client-side backoffs at 11:59.
infra-lee: Provider says they can allocate some spare nodes in another region. Recommend cross-region fallback for certain instance families. Need cost approval for cross-region surge.
eng-platform-sam: Implementing controller flag to allow cross-region fallback for family a100-40g when local quota exhausted. Rolling in 1 minute.
finance-mike: Approve emergency cross-region for up to 2 hours. Flag any spend beyond that.
incident-bot: Autoscaler: issuing scale requests to eu-north for 10 nodes. Provider admitted 7/10 due to limits.
oncall-ryan: Added manual per-key throttles for top 5 heavy clients. Using conservative rates to avoid SLA impact.
sre-judy: Commands: ```bash
redwoodctl rate-limit set --key key-heavy-01 --pct 30 --ttl 3600
redwoodctl rate-limit set --key key-batch-77 --pct 40 --ttl 3600
``` applied.
cs-paula: Notifying CSMs for keys we've throttled: key-heavy-01 -> ByteLabs (contacted), key-batch-77 -> ScoreCorp (voicemail).
customer-note-bot: Draft for ops review: "We are mitigating a transient GPU capacity shortage impacting hosted EU-west. Actions include routing, throttles, and temporary fallback pools. We'll follow up with timeline and postmortem." Approve to send in 25m?
ops-nina: Wait 25m. We'll send single consolidated update.
eng-platform-sam: Observability: adding synthetic probe to detect provider quota errors and triage quicker. Deploying to staging.
noncall-ryan: (typo correction) -> oncall-ryan: queue now 4.2k, tmp-burst utilization 54%. p50 token latency 0.8s; p95 1.2s. Progressing.
sre-judy: Noted a noisy key still causing sustained pressure (key-realtime-demo). I'll temporarily deprioritize it to background priority.
ops-nina: Good. Prepare an incident summary channel and handoff to postmortem owners.
noncall-ryan: final state capture: at 12:13 UTC queue drained to normal ~180 reqs. Temp pool will be disabled after 30m of stable metrics. Incident duration ~25m from page to stable.
incident-bot: Pager resolved (auto). Root cause: provider quota exhaustion for A100 in eu-west combined with controller backoff policy that delayed fallback.
ops-nina: Post-incident notes: Root cause: provider-side shortage + autoscaler conservative backoff. Contributing factors: recent eviction-guard=false rollout increased density on same instance family; lack of pre-warm cross-region pools. Mitigations executed: temp-burst pool, cross-region fallback, route overrides, per-key throttles, batch gating. Customer impact: hosted shared pool free-tier had most 5xxs; small fraction of hosted paid customers experienced latency increase but no confirmed SLA breach.
ops-nina: Action items (owner / due): 1) Autoscaler: implement provider-rate-aware fast-failover and allow cross-region fallback config (eng-platform-sam) - due in 72h. 2) Capacity: increase instance-family diversity & pre-warm cross-region pools (infra-lee) - due 14 days. 3) Rollouts: add rollout guard for eviction-guard toggles and monitor instance-family utilization (eng-runtime-ana) - due 7 days. 4) Monitoring: add synthetic quota-failure test and new alert thresholds for enqueue growth (sre-judy) - due 48h. 5) Customer comms: prepare postmortem and send impacted-customer list to CSMs (cs-paula) - due 24h. 6) Finance: set emergency cross-region spend threshold & auto-approval workflow (finance-mike) - due 7 days.
eng-platform-sam: I'll open a design PR for autoscaler fast-failover and link it into the postmortem channel.
sre-judy: Creating synthetic test that simulates provider 429/quota errors. Will validate in staging and then prod.
cs-paula: I'll draft the customer timeline and coordinate with ops-nina for dist.
ops-nina: Handoff: oncall-ryan -> postmortem lead. Please attach logs, exact commands executed, and metric snapshots to the postmortem doc. Closing live coordination thread.
oncall-ryan: Compiling logs + timeline now. tagging follow-ups.
incident-bot: Thread closed by oncall-ryan.
